title: Users may be unable to join Microsoft Teams meetings and see sign-in errors

updates.content:
Title: Some users may be unable to join Microsoft Teams meetings and see sign-in errors

User impact: Users may be unable to join Microsoft Teams meetings and see sign-in errors.

More info: Affected users see a sign-in prompt when attempting to join a meeting but clicking "sign-in" on the prompt has no effect.

Users can sign-out and sign back in as a temporary mitigation.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Teams and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Some users may be unable to join Microsoft Teams meetings and see sign-in errors

User impact: Users may be unable to join Microsoft Teams meetings and see sign-in errors.

More info: Affected users see a sign-in prompt when attempting to join a meeting but clicking "sign-in" on the prompt has no effect.

Users can sign-out and sign back in as a temporary mitigation.

Current status: We're reviewing the logs provided by a subset of affected users and have requested an additional set of fresh logs from those users to assist in pinpointing the underlying root cause of this event, so we may develop the most effective remediation steps.

Scope of impact: Some users may be unable to join Microsoft Teams meetings and see sign-in errors. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Title: Users may be unable to join Microsoft Teams meetings and see sign-in errors

Users can sign-out and sign back in as a temporary mitigation.

Final status: We've completed the deployment of our code fix to all affected environments and confirmed through telemetry, along with a subset of impacted users, that the issue is resolved.

Scope of impact: Some users who attempted to join Microsoft Teams meetings may have been affected by this issue.

Start time: Wednesday, October 7, 2026, at 1:00 AM UTC

End time: Friday, October 16, 2026, at 3:30 AM UTC

Root cause: A recent change to the authentication flow utilized in the event contained a regression, which resulted in impact.

Next steps: 
- We're reviewing our feature update testing and validation methods to better identify the potential for impact to the Microsoft Teams meetings and sign-in authentication path prior to deployment to prevent similar impact in the future, and to improve our pre-deployment update testing processes.

This is the final update for the event.
